studies.title: Lawful son; his father
studies.reading: sone lawfull ... his said umqle father
studies.context: Read sone lawfull to the defunct directly after Archibald's wrapped surname.
studies.locator_note: Read sone lawfull to the defunct directly after Archibald's wrapped surname. Follow the later his said umqle father for the reciprocal relationship. Executor dative is a separate office and would not alone establish sonship.
studies.conclusion: This establishes William and Archibald's relationship, not Archibald's mother.
